tools.name: kobiyi_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (cari) with optional search by name, tax number, your ERP externalId, or changes since a time. Kobiyi API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its record counts and credit risk (limit, used, available, overdue, level: none, ok, warn, over). Kobiyi API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact (cari) in Kobiyi. Only name is required. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_receivables
tools.description: List receivables (invoices owed to you) with status, contact, currency, due-date and invoice-date filters. Kobiyi API: GET /receivables.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_receivable
tools.description: Get one receivable by id, with its status and amounts. Kobiyi API: GET /receivables/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_receivable
tools.description: Create a receivable (an invoice owed to you) for a contact. contact_id and amount are required. With external_id, posting again returns the existing record. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /receivables.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_payables
tools.description: List payables (amounts you owe) with status, contact, currency, date and external-id filters. Kobiyi API: GET /payments.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_payable
tools.description: Get one payable by id. Kobiyi API: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_payable
tools.description: Create a payable (an amount you owe) for a contact. contact_id, amount and date (the due date) are required. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /payments.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_collections
tools.description: List collections (money received against receivables), filterable by receivable, date range and external id. Kobiyi API: GET /collections.

tools.name: kobiyi_record_collection
tools.description: Record money received against a receivable. The receivable status updates; excess money becomes a contact advance. Pass a new idempotency_key per payment. Kobiyi API: POST /collections (Idempotency-Key header).

tools.name: kobiyi_list_payment_transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (money paid against payables), filterable by payable and date range. Kobiyi API: GET /payment-transactions.

tools.name: kobiyi_record_payment_transaction
tools.description: Record money you paid against a payable. The payable status updates; excess money becomes a supplier advance. Pass a new idempotency_key per payment. Kobiyi API: POST /payment-transactions (Idempotency-Key header).

tools.name: kobiyi_list_products
tools.description: List income categories (products). These are categories, not stock items. Kobiyi API: GET /products.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_expenses
tools.description: List expense categories (gider kalemleri) with their main and sub category keys. Kobiyi API: GET /expenses.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_cash_accounts
tools.description: List cash, bank, POS and cheque accounts with currency and balance (balance can be null). Kobiyi API: GET /cash-accounts.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_cheques
tools.description: List received (RECEIVED) and given (GIVEN) cheques with status and due date. Kobiyi API: GET /cheques.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank statement and online bank transactions with their match status (MATCHED, UNMATCHED, ADVANCE and others). Kobiyi API: GET /bank-transactions.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_cari_advances
tools.description: List contact advances (customer or supplier prepayments) with the amount still unused. Zero balances are hidden unless include_zero is true. Kobiyi API: GET /cari-advances.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_exchange_rates
tools.description: List the stored exchange rates (one current rate per currency pair, no history). Kobiyi API: GET /exchange-rates.
